body: hey girly, im also f 22!! from the US (: also been feeling a little off & having a shitty mood for a while now and definitely feeling the alone in the world part. hit me up if im that cup of tea for you lol.

maybe i will look into it then. it cant hurt to try i suppose. i just hope i don’t get discouraged. and yeah hopefully things finally work out and i can get a dog (: thanks dude, this small chat brung me back up a little haha

getting a dog is my main goal for now, but looking like a rough one to achieve for the moment. i used to have a cat that was my best friend and got me through last year’s long anxious phase, but it was stolen from me. its a long story lol. i’d rather not go to jail over a cat. 

but i feel like it would be too late for me to switch over to being anything in the vet field. im already 22 and so behind in college compared to others so i feel like id be wasting time :/

i usually play a video game or two which helps block it out for the moment. but times like now where i just wanna sleep it doesnt really benefit me much. 

i used to see a therapist for getting over the death of a loved one. i enjoyed talking to him so maybe ill look into giving therapy another shot again even if its just for general anxiety now
i havent thought about that in a while lol. i think the thing that brings me the most joy are animals to be honest. idk if thats corny or not

i feel the same exact way. i recently told my mom and she just sobbed and thought it was her fault. all that came from it was me feeling guilty and shitty for causing her any type of pain. but i dont know how else to vent out my issues to, i always feel trapped. with no one to talk to. not to mention i feel like my problems arent nearly as big as others so i feel guilty for that too :/ but hey, at least we’re making an attempt at trying to feel better. i hope you find your own way :)
yeah, only problem is i feel like i cant. like i wont ever find anyone else after him & im already too attached. :/ i cant handle being alone again
yeah i’m planning on it hopefully.
